verdict.rationale: Reflect's API docs link to a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference hosted on openpm, covering graphs, links, daily-notes, notes and users/me with OAuth2 scopes. The docs also include a copy-pasteable curl example against the live REST base. Nothing shows this reference is interactive (no try-it console or explorer), and the vendor's own domain returns 404 for every OpenAPI path probed. Missing for 10: an interactive explorer with in-browser runnable examples, a sandbox or test environment, per-endpoint example requests beyond a single curl snippet, and any independent corroboration.
